content:
Has anyone been finding the Android app unusable recently because if you click anywhere in the message (e.g. to edit previously written text) it selects from your cursor to that point instead of moving the cursor?

It seems like an unlikely thing to be app specific, but I don't have this problem elsewhere.

We're aware of it -- it's discussed at https://chat.zulip.org/#narrow/channel/48-mobile/topic/edit.20message.20highlights.20all.20message.20text.20.28Android.29/with/2420576

The summary is that it's a bug in Flutter, the Google library we use to build the mobile app, tracked as https://github.com/flutter/flutter/issues/184744. It looks like they've opened https://github.com/flutter/flutter/pull/185292 for a fix, but it hasn't been merged yet yet.

The workaround I've been using is that when I'm in this mess I try to click so that I'm only highlighting a few characters and then delete the characters, type some more, delete those, and then try again.

I happened to have the "Text editing" 'customisation' enabled on stock Android 16, which gives a way to manually leave selection mode, but it's quite a button intensive workaround

Screenshot_20260426-225509.pngScreenshot_20260426-225554.png
(left: customisation screen. right: said mode, active)
According to the link, it's the shift key that causes the bug and the space key which gets you out of the mess. Didn't check yet
FWIW I write in a separated app with self-messages like Signal or Telegram, and copy-paste.
